name: referee-validate ADR cross-link walker
purpose: Extend the load-then-invert walker's referential-integrity pass (`collectBrokenReferences` in `packages/rcf-lite/src/core/store/walker.js`) to check the two ADR-schema-declared reference fields that the 0.27.0 walker skipped: `supersededBy` (single ADR id) and `relatedAdrs` (array of ADR ids). Each present target must resolve to a loaded ADR; a mismatch surfaces as a `brokenReference` error named to the ADR file, keyed by field. An absent or empty field is silent.
responsibilities: Inside `collectBrokenReferences`, after the existing ADR->TAD parent check, walk `supersededBy` when it is a non-empty string and delegate to the existing `check` helper with expectedKind `adr` (AC-16001-1).
Iterate every entry in `relatedAdrs ?? []`, delegate each to the same `check` helper with a field name `relatedAdrs[i]` naming the array index (AC-16001-2).
Reuse the existing `brokenReference` error shape (kind, documentId, filePath, field, rule) so downstream consumers of `formatErrors` need no change.
Ensure the widened check contributes to `tree.brokenIds` exactly the way the existing checks do.
internalStructure: Two additional call blocks appended to the existing ADR loop inside `collectBrokenReferences`. The `check` helper is unchanged. Neither field is required by the ADR schema, so an omitted or empty field never emits an error; the check runs only on a present target.
notes: Existing WSD projects that carry stale supersededBy pointers will start failing validate on upgrade; that is the intended behaviour (the referee-guarantees docs page promises exactly this refusal). Failures name the ADR file and the field so the fix is a one-line edit or a `define update` write.
